theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A premium auto workshop requires a luxurious, moody aesthetic for marketing to build trust and convey high-end care. The internal admin panel must prioritize clarity, fast reading, and operational efficiency under bright workshop lighting, dictating a crisp Light Theme.

typography.installation: yarn add @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans. For Cabinet Grotesk, import via Fontshare API in index.html.

public_site.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Wide Tetris grids for services.

admin_dashboard.strategy: Control Room Grid. Dense, space-efficient, strict alignment.

surface_strategies.public_nav: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
surface_strategies.public_cards: Flat background (bg-[#111111]), 1px subtle white/10 border, hover state: -translate-y-1, border-white/30.
surface_strategies.admin_panels: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm max), solid white background, 1px solid border (#E5E7EB), no heavy shadows.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#F59E0B] text-black font-bold hover:bg-[#D97706]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5.

shadcn_customizations.inputs: Public: bg-black/50 border-white/20 text-white. Admin: bg-white border-gray-300 text-black.
shadcn_customizations.dialogs: Public: Glassy backdrop, dark surface. Admin: Standard opaque overlay.

icons.usage: Use duotone or bold weights for public services, regular weight for admin density.

animations.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-ups for public site sections.

accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-button', data-testid='admin-login-input').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images uses text-shadow or gradient overlays. The Golden Amber CTA with black text meets high contrast standards.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. STRUCTURE: The app requires two completely distinct layouts. A dark-themed marketing/booking flow (Public) and a light-themed operational dashboard (Admin).
2. PUBLIC BOOKING FLOW: Build a multi-step booking form. Break it down: Select Service -> Date/Time -> Customer Info -> Confirmation. Use Framer Motion for smooth step transitions.
3. ADMIN DASHBOARD: Prioritize data density. Use Shadcn tables for booking management. Include workflow status pills (Pending, In-Progress, Completed).
4. VISUAL IDENTITY: Strictly adhere to the Cabinet Grotesk + IBM Plex Sans font pairing. Use the Golden Amber color (#F59E0B) intentionally for CTAs and active states, NOT as large background blocks.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided Pexels image URLs for the public site's hero and service bento-grid. Apply a bg-black/50 to bg-black/70 overlay on the hero image to ensure the H1 is perfectly legible.
6. Do not use placehold.it or similar dummy images. If more images are needed, use abstract CSS gradients using the brand colors.
7. Set up Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all iconography.
8. Ensure all forms use fully customized Shadcn UI components matching the active theme.
